semantic_model_revision.note: Semantic-model revision: the governed model declarations these artifacts were generated from, contained byte-for-byte in source_revision. The ontology/kernel contract supplies declaration locators only; the model files carry the semantics.

api_binding.note: O2.1 produces no validated SysML API project/commit closure and claims no current API element UUID. Retained privileged-run evidence is representation-shape evidence only.

definition.documentation: One of the 13 phases of the DE4SDV increment workflow.

members.name: phase0_incrementFraming
members.documentation: What are we changing or learning? Common domain.

members.name: phase1_concernFraming
members.documentation: Who cares and why? Common/Operational domain.

members.name: phase2_operationalContext
members.documentation: What happens in the world? Operational domain.

members.name: phase3_capabilityClassification
members.documentation: Feature, common capability, constraint, or evidence? DE4SDV ontology.

members.name: phase4_needs
members.documentation: What stakeholder needs exist? Operational domain.

members.name: phase5_requirements
members.documentation: What shall the system do? Conceptual domain.

members.name: phase6_functionalArchitecture
members.documentation: What functions, flows, states, interfaces? Conceptual domain.

members.name: phase7_logicalArchitecture
members.documentation: What technology-independent logical elements realize functions? Conceptual domain.

members.name: phase8_physicalRealization
members.documentation: What software/hardware realizes the logical design, and which applicable logical or semantic signals cross into typed software contracts? Physical domain.

members.name: phase9_variabilityConfiguration
members.documentation: How does this vary across member products? DE4SDV product-line layer.

members.name: phase10_vvEvidence
members.documentation: How will satisfaction be checked? Common/Conceptual domain.

members.name: phase11_publication
members.documentation: What is reviewable now? DE4SDV workflow.

members.name: phase12_baselineNextSlice
members.documentation: What is accepted, deferred, or invalidated? Common domain.

kernel_binding_contract.resolution: ingestion-validated kernel binding: exactly one API element whose declaredName and @type match the governed declaration and whose serializer-recorded source document equals the bound source file; multiple candidates are ambiguous and zero candidates is unresolved (both fail closed); the runtime consumes the resulting KernelElementBinding through KernelBindingIndex, never a name-based fallback

definition.documentation: A typed model-resident method-contract obligation: stable explicit identifier, phase reference, typed subject selector, restricted applicability, population policy, pinned predicate with declared input/output types, target filters, per-subject cardinality bounds, requiredness, evaluation source, optional attestation-policy reference, and exact claim boundary. Model materialization of the frozen baseline Section 7 schema. Stable explicit identifier; unique in the selected method. Reference to an existing MethodPhase literal; never a phase-specific Python branch. Typed selection from the declared evaluation scope; no free-text inference. Restricted typed condition over pinned model/configuration data. Explicit permitted-empty disposition; an empty population without it is not a pass. Pinned ontology predicate identifier with declared input/output types. Typed conditions on returned targets, not implicitly on subjects. Integer bounds over distinct qualifying targets per applicable subject. Whether failure blocks this declared contract scope. Policy identity required when acceptance/approval is part of the obligation; may be empty. Exact claim supported when this obligation passes.
